title: Get negative keywords
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the list of negative keywords for Search Ads. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/search_ad/negative_keyword/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | object_type {Required} | string | Object type. Use this field to specify whether you want to get the list of negative keywords for a campaign or ad group.

Enum values:
  • `CAMPAIGN`: campaign.
  • `ADGROUP`: ad group.
| | object_id {Required} | string | Object ID. Use this field to pass in a campaign ID or ad group ID that you want to get the list of negative keywords for.

Specify this field according to `object_type`:
  • If `object_type` is `CAMPAIGN`, assign a campaign ID to this field.
  • If `object_type` is `ADGROUP`, assign an ad group ID to this field.
| | page | number | The number of pages you want to include the results in.

Default value: 1.

Value range: ≥ 1 | | page_size | number | Page size.

Default value: 10.

Value range: [1,50]. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/search_ad/negative_keyword/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&object_type=CAMPAIGN&object_id={{object_id}}&page=1&page_size=50' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | | data | object | Returned data.

If no negative word is found, an empty list will be returned. | #| keywords | object[] | Information about negative words.

Max size: 1,000. | ##| keyword_id | string | ID of the negative keyword. | ##| name | string | Name of the negative keyword. | ##| match_type | string | Match type for the negative keyword.

Enum values:
  • `PRECISE_WORD`: exact match.
  • `PHRASE_WORD`: phrase match.
  • `BROAD_WORD`: broad match.
| #| page_info | object | Pagination information. | ##| page | number | Current page number. | ##| page_size | number | Page size. | ##| total_number | number | Total number of results. | ##| total_page | number | Total pages of results. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "keywords": [ { "match_type": "BROAD_WORD", "name": "{{name}}", "keyword_id": "{{keyword_id}}" }, { "match_type": "BROAD_WORD", "name": "{{name}}", "keyword_id": "{{keyword_id}}" } ], "page_info": { "total_number": 2, "page": 1, "total_page": 1, "page_size": 50 } } } (/code) ```
